def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    fives=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    if not fives: return g
    r0,c0=min(fives)
    p=(r0+c0)%2
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        nz=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=0]
        if len(nz)<2: continue
        lo,hi=min(nz),max(nz)
        for c in range(lo+1,hi):
            if g[r][c]==0 and (r+c)%2==p:
                g[r][c]=5
    return g
